title: Byte-identical receipt proof for the deterministic rule path
claim: On a fixed input set of real windows (150 gold IndEgo + 30 OOD Egocentric-10K), the deterministic rule scorer produces the same receipt SHA-256 for every window across 10 fresh-process runs (same machine), and a deliberately perturbed input or threshold does change the receipt.

canonicalisation.quantisation: Q=4 fixed point: round(value * 10**4), decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN; comparisons on ints only

environment.device: CPU only (no GPU in the rule path)
